instructions: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: You will hear a conversation between a customer and an agent at an art academy.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: First, you have some time to read through questions one to four.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to four.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hello, this is the Ridley Art Academy. Come in. Can I help you with anything?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Yes, I just moved to town and am interested in enrolling my child in an art programme.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: So I wanted to see what kinds of classes you offer.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Wonderful! We have several art courses for children.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: If you could give me a few pieces of information first, I'd appreciate it. Could I get your name?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Pablo Marquez, that's spelled M-A-R-Q-U-E-Z.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: And the age of your child?
transcript.highlight_text: And the age of your child?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Just turned ten, about four months ago.
transcript.highlight_text: Just turned ten, about four months ago.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Well, we have a few different courses for that age group.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: One is Introduction to Art, which includes painting, drawing and lots of fun activities.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: We also offer sculpture workshop where the children work with different sculpting materials

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: and history of art where the children learn a bit about famous artists and art movements.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I think the introductory class would be best.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Good. Now, we currently have sixteen children enrolled in that course,

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: but we have a teacher and two assistants with them at all times.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Great! And how much do you charge?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Actually, we charge per month. The cost would be £160 and you pay at the beginning of each month.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: But if you enroll for a period of a full year, the rate is only £120 per month.
transcript.highlight_text: if you enroll for a period of a full year, the rate is only £120 per month.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Really? Well, we plan to enroll for a year anyway.
transcript.highlight_text: we plan to enroll for a year anyway.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: OK, I would like to go ahead if there is space.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Absolutely. The classes will start this coming Tuesday.
transcript.highlight_text: The classes will start this coming Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's fine. So, that's February 2nd, right?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's correct. And payment is accepted by cash, credit card or check. Which do you prefer?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll pay with my credit card. Thanks.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Sure. Now, if I could just get you to fill in this enrolment form, I'll go ahead and take care of your payment.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: And then I'll get you a brochure about the academy and a copy of your child's art class schedule.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Also, there is a list of our policies which you can look through and...

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: You now have 15 seconds to check your answers.
